title: A risk.sensitive !glob excludes its matches from every sensitive rule
description: With risk.sensitive [{rule:'per-app manifests', glob:'!apps/*/package.json'}], the generic positive list stays in force: a change to apps/pm/package.json classifies normal and the merge gate decision does not wait for approval, while root package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml stay sensitive and wait; a repository with no exclusions classifies as before.

steps.name: Classify and gate excluded and still-sensitive paths
